subject: MAP + Eval Plan: Volume lift and staggered ramp proposal for EdgeScale
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samiha Rahman <samiha@edgescale.com>, Tom Keller <tkeller@edgescale.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + Eval Plan: Volume lift and staggered ramp proposal for EdgeScale

Hi Samiha / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our call I put together a concise mutual action plan (attached) that aligns the evaluation milestones to a staged commitment so you can validate latency and cost at production scale without an all‑in ramp. High level:

- Evaluation window: 4 weeks (pilot) with an initial canary of 50 TPM (tokens per minute) for your public search path.
- Ramp schedule (monthly TPM targets) tied to milestone gates:
  - Month 1 (post-eval): 250 TPM
  - Month 2: 750 TPM
  - Month 3+: 1500 TPM steady state
- Pricing/discount triggers: 5% uplift discount at Month 2 when Month 1 acceptance gates are met; 12% committed discount at Month 3 on a 12‑month term.
- Evaluation credits: we can provide $15k in hosting credits during the pilot to offset costs.

Please review the attached MAP spreadsheet (EdgeScale_MAP_v1.xlsx) — it maps success criteria, owner, deliverables and legal/SOW touchpoints. Specific asks for you: confirm the Month 1 TPM target and whether the acceptance criteria (p95 latency < 120ms; error rate < 0.5%) are achievable.

If that looks reasonable I’ll loop in Legal and get a draft SOW out (attached) and propose DocuSign for signature flows.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0127

Attachments: EdgeScale_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-draft-EdgeScale.pdf (pdf)

From: Samiha Rahman <samiha@edgescale.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tkeller@edgescale.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Plan: Volume lift and staggered ramp proposal for EdgeScale

Ben —

Appreciate the clear breakdown and the credit offer. A few immediate questions from our side:

1) TPM math — our current baseline is ~90 TPM on search during peak; jumping to 250 in Month 1 feels aggressive. Can we do a softer ramp: 150 -> 400 -> 1200?
2) Discount timing — we prefer the committed discount to kick in after Month 4 steady state rather than Month 3. Our procurement needs a longer validation window.
3) Acceptance criteria — p95 < 120ms is fine, but we need end‑to‑end SLA checks including upstream caching behavior. Can Priyom help scope those tests?

Assuming we agree on 1+2 above we can get procurement to prioritize SOW review.

Thanks,
Samiha
Samiha Rahman
Head of Platform Engineering, EdgeScale
samiha@edgescale.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samiha Rahman <samiha@edgescale.com>, Tom Keller <tkeller@edgescale.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Plan: Volume lift and staggered ramp proposal for EdgeScale

Samiha —

Thanks for the feedback. We can absolutely smooth the ramp. Updated proposal:

- Pilot / Eval (4 weeks): canary at 50 TPM as before, with Priyom owning test plan.
- Month 1: 150 TPM
- Month 2: 400 TPM
- Month 3: 800 TPM
- Month 4+: 1200 TPM steady state

Discounts: shift committed discount to post‑Month 4 if you prefer. To keep economics neutral for Redwood we can tier the discount: 6% at Month 4 (on receipt of acceptance) and 12% once Month 6 steady state (12‑month commitment). We’ll hold the $15k evaluation credit as proposed and apply it to first‑month invoices if you move to SOW within 30 days.

Priyom — can you scope the E2E acceptance tests (include upstream cache warm/cold runs, p95 measurement methodology, and traffic mix)? I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet and re‑attach.

If EdgeScale signs off on the adjusted ramp I’ll get Legal to prep a revised SOW for procurement.

—Ben

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samiha Rahman <samiha@edgescale.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Plan: Volume lift and staggered ramp proposal for EdgeScale

Hi Samiha / Tom —

I sketched an acceptance plan and test matrix (will attach a short doc to the MAP):
- Tests: cold cache start, steady traffic, burst at 3x peak, degradation under dropped GPU node, KV cache warmup timing.
- Metrics: p95 latency (endpoint and end‑to‑end), error rate, cost per 1M tokens.
- Owners: EdgeScale to provide replay traces (Tom), Redwood to run canary and provide tracelog.
- Success gates: 1) p95 endpoint < 120ms for steady traffic, 2) error rate < 0.5%, 3) tail‑latency under 2x baseline during bursts.

I can take a 30‑minute call next week to walk through the matrix. When would you have 30 minutes?

Cheers,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samiha Rahman <samiha@edgescale.com>, Tom Keller <tkeller@edgescale.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Plan: Volume lift and staggered ramp proposal for EdgeScale

Ben / team —

This ramp looks reasonable from a commercial perspective. We can approve the revised discount ladder (6% at Month 4, 12% at Month 6) provided procurement signs the SOW and legal completes a standard confidentiality addendum. Ben — please flag if EdgeScale wants earlier discount acceleration; I can approve a one‑time additional credit but anything beyond that needs CRO signoff.

Thanks — looping Legal to start the SOW review.
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Tom Keller <tkeller@edgescale.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Plan: Volume lift and staggered ramp proposal for EdgeScale

Ben / Priyom / Marissa —

Thanks — the ramp & acceptance gates make sense. We can commit to the Month 1→Month 4 ramp (150 / 400 / 800 / 1200) subject to Legal/Proc review of the SOW. Procurement indicated they want the committed discount tied to a signed 12‑month term after Month 6 (the 12% cadence). We will send replay traces tomorrow and schedule the 30‑minute test plan call for next Tue 09/08.

Samiha also asked me to confirm: can Redwood provide a one‑time migration credit if we sign the SOW within 21 days? That would help us accelerate procurement.

Tom
Tom Keller
Director, Platform Engineering | EdgeScale

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Keller <tkeller@edgescale.com>, Samiha Rahman <samiha@edgescale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Eval Plan: Volume lift and staggered ramp proposal for EdgeScale

Tom / Samiha —

Yes — we can offer a one‑time $10k migration credit if the SOW is signed within 21 days of the final SOW delivery. I’ll update the MAP and ask Legal to reflect the conditions in the SOW (credit applied to first invoice post-signature).

Next steps:
- Redwood to update MAP and SOW (Ben) — delivery by Fri 09/03.
- EdgeScale to send replay traces (Tom) — expected 09/03.
- Test plan call scheduled for Tue 09/08 (30 minutes) — invite pending.

Appreciate the quick turn — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Ben
